prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: portrait 4:5 website everyday-learning photograph.
Primary request: a much wider, human-free music practice still life with two small CYMBA wired earbuds casually left on a closed music notebook in the lower-right third. Genuine editorial photography, believable scale, plenty of room around objects.
Input images: image 1 and image 2 are GEOMETRY AND MATERIAL REFERENCES ONLY of the same compact earbud, its outer face and inner face. Do not copy their upright pose, tight crop, scale or camera angle.
Scene: a light warm-grey desk, a compact musical keyboard runs diagonally across the rear / upper portion. A charcoal clothbound closed music notebook sits lower right, a single ordinary pencil beside it. The main middle-left area has quiet open desk space. Soft neutral afternoon window light, realistic fine material detail.
Product arrangement and camera: high oblique wide view, looking downward across the setting from around 55 degrees. Earbuds occupy a SMALL area (each earbud comparable in width to one white piano key, about 2.5cm, never as big as a fist). Two buds lie casually flat against the notebook on different sides of a loosely coiled fine black braided cable. One bud is turned away and rolled to show its inner/back, with nozzle pointing toward upper-left of image; the second bud lies on its opposite side, turned almost sideways with nozzle toward lower-right. They are separated by loose cable and point in clearly different directions, never an aligned upright pair. Let the cable relax in overlapping imperfect loops. Controller only if it falls naturally among the cable at a much smaller scale.
Locked hardware: small smoked charcoal resin shell, oval satin black faceplate with thin champagne perimeter rim, curved plain-black concha fin, short nozzle with smoke grey silicone tip. Only where visible, two oval champagne contacts arranged together on inner body with separate optical window; narrow tip contact insets. No contacts on fin. Cable connected to the device's bottom socket, rotating with each physical earbud rather than forced toward image-bottom. No invented hardware.
Composition: large music-practice environment, open breathing room and compact earbuds in lower-right, keyboard soft yet recognisable at rear. These are small earphones casually put down, not upright catalogue display models. Restrained graphite, grey, muted champagne palette. Natural shallow-to-moderate depth of field; notebook and earphones sharply resolved at their true scale.
Avoid: no people, hands, faces, branding, legible text, watermarks, staged central symmetrical hero pair, large upright earbuds, upright fins, giant products, hero-style controller in foreground, excessive golden light, floating earbuds. Output a single portrait 4:5 photographic image.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied music-practice photograph.
Keep this photograph's desk, musical keyboard, closed notebook, pencil, background, neutral lighting, wide framing, exact materials and product geometry.
Change ONLY the physical orientations of the two earbuds and their nearby cable to eliminate the identical upright pose. This must be an obvious pose change:
1. FRONT lower/right earbud: turn the ENTIRE object roughly 130 degrees clockwise in the picture. Lay it flat so its BLACK CURVED FIN points diagonally DOWN-LEFT toward 7 o'clock. Its cable socket consequently points diagonally UP-RIGHT toward 1 o'clock, and its cable curves rightwards into the loose coil. Its oval champagne-rimmed faceplate remains visible obliquely from above.
2. REAR upper/left earbud: turn the ENTIRE object roughly 90 degrees counterclockwise in the picture. Lay it on its side, fin extending horizontally LEFT at 9 o'clock and silicone tip pointing UP toward 12 o'clock. Cable leaves toward RIGHT at 3 o'clock. It shows the smoked inner body, its two champagne oval contacts and separate small optical window at realistic small scale.
The parts are all permanently attached and rotate together as rigid products. Do not bend, distort, rearrange, or redesign hardware. These are casually laid-down earphones pointing opposite ways, not miniature figures standing on a desk. Each earbud must visibly lie on its side against notebook with realistic contact shadow. Exactly TWO earbuds. Preserve correct compact product scale, only slightly smaller if needed. Keep surrounding generous open desk space, loosely coiled braided cable and notebook. No people or text. Final single portrait 4:5 photograph.
iterations.qa: Accepted physical posing and arrangement. Both fins rotate left/down-left with different body faces; requested targeted contact/controller correction.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied photograph is the edit target. Preserve the entire photograph, including camera angle, exact product placements and size, and both earbuds' new lying-down rotated poses. Preserve all surrounding notebook, desk and musical keyboard pixels as closely as possible. Fix ONLY two small hardware details:
On the rear upper-left earbud's inner body, there must be a pair of TWO separate little oval champagne contact pads beside the greenish optical window, rather than only one gold pad. Add the second matching oval contact beside the existing one along the body's available surface, following its rotation and perspective. Do not put metal on the black curved fin.
The small inline black barrel on the cable coil at the upper-right of notebook should instead be a short slim charcoal rounded rectangular inline controller with exactly three very discreet small round dark buttons, at its same small scale and position.
No other changes. Do not enlarge, stand up or rearrange the earbuds. In particular the front bud's fin keeps pointing down-left and the rear bud's fin keeps pointing left. Maintain portrait 4:5 photorealism.
iterations.qa: Final accepted. Two laid-down earbuds with opposing rotated faces in lower-right third, coiled cable, compact keyboard in rear diagonal, generous breathing room, no humans. Rear inner body has two visible contact pads and separate optical window; compact three-button controller. Contacts are simplified at scene scale; this is an environmental photo rather than a technical geometry reference.

qa.orientation: Both buds lie down with fin pointing left/down-left; different inner and outer faces.
qa.composition: Wider high oblique music scene; no repeat upright large hero pair.
